coordinate_system: original_google_sheet; immutable CSV review uses different coordinates

implementation.profile: chorus_d2:outgoing extracted from strand_defense into combat_damage.json; ability_stat multiplier stage is separate from legacy perk maximum and live outgoing_debuff resistance
implementation.binding: Host explicitly binds one chorus_d2:ability_stat_damage SOURCE per participating combatant, independent of selected ability or equipped armor. No production automatic character assembly yet.
implementation.classification: Exactly one of chorus:melee_damage or chorus:grenade_damage selects this ordinary attack policy; both or neither contributes no stat bonus. Source weapon/ability strings do not infer credit. Glaive melee requires explicit melee credit.
implementation.sampling: on_use values freeze with capture_damage; uncaptured direct DamageCommand queries current attributes. Arcbolt captures at supplied impact signal before 1 second activation; Threaded Spike queries each contact. Explicit Chorus policies, not measured original Destiny behavior.
implementation.stacking: Derived stat query input is zero, caps after source contributions, returns delta in an independent multiply/MAX stage. Duplicate stat scaling bindings cannot multiply twice.

limits: This is reference content under test resources, not a released production content pack or automatic native punch/Glaive classifier.
Generic perk MAX is inherited from the existing fixture; complete Destiny melee additive subgroups, buffs, target and level scaling remain incomplete.
Dual-credit Grapple requires its dedicated combined-stat profile and classification; it must not use the ordinary mutually exclusive melee/grenade policy.
Scorch/Ignition inherit no bonus from an ability identity; their separate profiles and source-specific eligibility still need calibration.

Super damage versus Well/Ward duration, Class overshield and damaging Class abilities are not implemented here. Original E196 does include damaging Class ability scaling (.65% per point PvE; .1?% PvP); prior documentation saying Class has no damage bonus was corrected.
Stat coefficients follow current Compendium text, not a new in-game measurement. No new rounding or cross-mode combat policy is asserted.
The grenade chunk-gain text conflict recorded in armor-stat-inputs.json remains unresolved and is independent of enhanced damage.
